acf.speaker_position: Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Truckstop

blocks.html:
Apurva Misra, an accomplished Senior Machine Learning Engineer, blends her passion for technology with a talent for teaching. With a rich history of conducting engaging AI workshops across the US and Canada, she brings both expertise and enthusiasm to the learning experience. Apurva holds a Master’s degree from the University of Waterloo, where she delved into the intriguing crossroads of driving technology and machine learning in her research.

Her interest doesn't stop at academia; she's also deeply involved in the start-up ecosystem, consulting for start-ups and always eager to engage in conversations about the latest tech developments, as highlighted in TechCrunch.

Outside of her professional pursuits, Apurva is an avid culinary explorer, always on the lookout for those unique, hidden dining spots. Don't hesitate to share your favourite eatery with her - she'd love to hear about it!
